original_test_intent: Verify PCIe port links for the eight specified AMDXIO GPU indices are present, correctly mapped and show no negotiated downgrade or issue.
original_method: Agent runs the exact pinned read-only AMDXIO command, parses every index's port speed/width/status and correlates it with the approved topology and PCIe logs.
manual_activity: User supplies/approves AMDXIO package, numeric index map and per-port criteria; agent performs read-only collection and user resolves discrepancies.
required_inputs: Vendor-approved AMDXIO binary/version/checksum and install method
Expected negotiated speed, width and valid status per port
Secure access, baseline logs and protected evidence storage
safety_requirements: Verify binary provenance and read-only syntax
Validate all numeric indices before query
Preserve complete output and exit status
Stop on missing/extra/unknown index, downshift, link/AER, driver, thermal/power or BMC fault
Do not reset links, change PCIe settings, update firmware or clear logs
agent_execution_scope: Run exact eight-index PCIe port query
Parse and compare every port plus logs
Do not reinterpret output as xGMI, mutate links, accept partial results or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Review full comparison and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The options and indices match, but unsafe credential handling, xGMI labeling and absent index/expected-value validation prevent reliable use.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the exact source command from the pinned AMDXIO build, preserve the full table and bind every numeric index to its approved BDF/port and negotiated criteria.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exact eight indices, PCIe list/ports operation, no-downgrade Criteria and source 5/5 timing are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a completeness-checked per-index GPU/BDF/port speed/width/status matrix with AER/log context.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable semantic mapping and explicit comparison without changing the read-only command.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No generic or xGMI result substitutes for the eight requested PCIe ports.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: AMDXIO numeric indices are platform/tool-version specific and can change with topology or firmware.

project_override_considerations: The project must own the numeric index mapping and accepted negotiated values; 'no downgrade' cannot be judged without them.
expected_evidence: Exact command, exit status and complete port table

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define AMDXIO PCIe port no-downgrade validation; mapping and exact expected values are prerequisite inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: AMDXIO package, index map and criteria are supplyable inputs; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Adds exact platform meaning and completeness checks to the numeric-index query and removes unsafe/xGMI-mislabeled evidence handling.
independent_technical_reasoning: Numeric AMDXIO indices are not stable hardware identities by themselves, so a healthy record for the wrong index can falsely pass an absent GPU port. Each index must be bound to an approved BDF/physical port and compared using negotiated speed/width, with full completeness and AER context.
